<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Decision Table Configuration">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="application.fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="application.rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="application.horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="application.incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else application.loan.amount / (if application.collateral.purchasePrice != null then min([application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue]) else application.collateral.appraisedValue) * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="application.creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else (sum(for v in [application.housing.principalInterest, application.housing.taxes, application.housing.insurance, application.housing.hoa, application.housing.mip] return if v = null then 0 else v) + (if application.debts != null then sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include = false or d.monthlyPayment = null then 0 else d.monthlyPayment) else 0)) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text>true</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-2">
          <text></text>

        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>

          <text></text>

        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text><=7</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text>"stable"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text><=80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">
          <text>>=720</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-3-output-1">
          <text>"ARM7/1"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-4">

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-6">
          <text><640</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-4-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-5">
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text>>50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-4">
          <text></text>

    </decisionTable>

</definitions>

testSuite.name: Fixed30 - Fixed Preference
testSuite.description: Applicant explicitly requested a fixed rate

testSuite.name: Fixed30 - High Sensitivity
testSuite.description: Applicant has high rate sensitivity

testSuite.name: ARM7/1 - Typical Case
testSuite.description: Applicant meets all criteria for 7/1 ARM

testSuite.name: ARM7/1 - Boundary Case
testSuite.description: Applicant meets all criteria at exact boundary values

testSuite.name: Manual Review - Low Credit Score
testSuite.description: Credit score is below 640

testSuite.name: Manual Review - High DTI
testSuite.description: DTI is above 50%

testSuite.name: Manual Review - High LTV
testSuite.description: LTV is above 95%

testSuite.name: Manual Review - Multiple Risk Factors
testSuite.description: Applicant has both low credit score and high LTV

testSuite.name: No Match - Middle Ground
testSuite.description: Applicant does not trigger any specific rule (Score 700, LTV 85)

testSuite.name: No Match - Variable Income
testSuite.description: Income stability is variable, failing ARM criteria

testSuite.name: No Match - Long Horizon
testSuite.description: Holding horizon is too long for ARM criteria

testSuite.name: No Match - Low Score for ARM
testSuite.description: Credit score is not high enough for ARM but not low enough for Manual Review

testSuite.name: Priority Test - Rule 1 vs Rule 2
testSuite.description: Rule 1 (Fixed30) should take precedence over Rule 2 (ARM) if both match

testSuite.name: Priority Test - Rule 1 vs Rule 3
testSuite.description: Rule 1 (Fixed30) should take precedence over Rule 3 (Manual) if both match

ManualReview через низький кредитний бал
Очікувано: ManualReview (бо creditScore < 640)

ManualReview через високий LTV
Очікувано: ManualReview (бо ltv > 95)

Очікувано: null або дефолтне рішення (залежно від політики у DMN)
